games.description: A solo exploration of the Complex’s yellow corridors. Sark tests the inventory and resources, searches its interconnected rooms, and ends the visit after a long maze expedition.
games.title: Backrooms Complex

games.description: A short solo trial of a third-person endless runner. Sark retries the obstacle course, dodges spikes and saws, and tests how far he can travel.
games.title: Backrooms Escape

games.description: Sark and NFEN try scavenging expeditions from a shared hub. They document entities and radiation, sell resources, buy gear and passes, and investigate contracts and crafting. A later brief visit returns to the game.
games.title: Backrooms Society

games.description: A short co-op trial with NFEN. Sark explores the dark rooms and furniture in a ten-report hunt before the pair moves on; no completed escape is confirmed.
games.title: Backrooms: The Entity

games.description: A short co-op backrooms attempt with NFEN, exploring the shifting maze and trying to break sight with the hunter.
games.title: Clipped Reality

games.description: A solo exploration of the procedural Backrooms, from the opening setup through the maze and later menu review. Sark searches the changing corridors and rooms during his wider Backrooms tour.
games.title: Enter the Backrooms

games.description: A co-op entity investigation with NFEN. Sark enters the research operation, explores its laboratory environments, uses the tablet’s evidence and rune tasks, and returns to the lobby during the search for an entity identification.
games.title: Entity Research Group

games.description: Sark explores WASABAE Studios’ original Backrooms game, inspecting its interior and the outdoor spaces beyond it during the final stretch of the Backrooms challenge.
games.title: The Backrooms 2019

games.description: Sark enters an early Backrooms game with a wristwatch, exploring the yellow rooms and checking his survival time and distance before closing the project.
games.title: The Backrooms Game
